AI for Agencies — May 2026 · Austin, Texas
We're in the midst of the most disruptive shift in the history of digital agencies.
Artificial Intelligence is not a passing trend—it's a tidal wave. Agencies that embrace it now will lead the next decade. Those that wait? They risk being left behind.
But tapping into that opportunity requires focus, intention, and urgency.
That's why we created this event.
You need a plan. Not later. Now!

Most agency owners are buried in client work or paralyzed by uncertainty when it comes to AI. But waiting even a few months could be fatal. The agencies that win in 2026 and beyond are building their AI strategy in the first half of 2026—not talking about it later.
Vistara is your moment to pause, reflect, and accelerate.
This isn't just another conference. It's a hands-on, two-day strategic intensive—plus a welcome reception—designed to future-proof your agency and help you adapt before disruption hits.
You and a key team member will:
Craft your agency's AI strategy and execution roadmap
Learn from top experts and agency operators actually using AI
Work side-by-side with the E2M AI Leadership Team, who currently supports 35+ agencies with real-world, real-time AI implementations
Explore over 80+ proven agency automations for lead gen, sales, delivery, and scale
Shift from reactive chaos to proactive clarity
"Companies that don't embrace AI will be disrupted by it—or by someone who already has."
Vistara isn't just about knowing what's possible with AI. It's about deciding who you want to be in the new era of agency work:
This event helps you zoom out, slow down, and recalibrate—so you can go faster and farther once you're back in the business.
to be scrambling to catch up in 2027?
to own the future by investing in strategy, innovation, and your team now?
The most successful agencies bring their COO, Ops Lead, and/or Head of Delivery.
This isn't just about learning—it's about building. And building happens best when your core team is aligned and activated. Consider our Agency VIP Pass if you're ready to hit the ground running.
Who should be in the room?
If you run an agency that delivers results, this event is built for you.
Vistara is for bold operators ready to lead—not lag—as AI reshapes the digital landscape.
Whether you're scaling fast or stabilizing systems, if you're serious about future-proofing your agency—this is where you need to be.
Vistara brings together forward-thinking agency leaders, innovators, and AI experts to share actionable strategies, real-world case studies, and cutting-edge insights.
